name: conference-tracker
notes: Single-page tracker of 131 conference and journal deadlines (README). Archetype is library: browse, filter, sort and search a collection, with Timeline, Cards, Table and Map as views of one dataset. Posture is transient: opened for a moment to check a deadline. Audience is self because it is Douglas's research tool (fit-for-you notes) even though it is deployed publicly at conference-tracker-rho.vercel.app. data=local because per-conference notes, stars and submission status live in localStorage. All server endpoints (/health, /api/conferences, /favicon.*, /cal.ics, catch-all page) are unauthenticated GET only: no writes, no CORS headers, so the deployment is read-only. No preset: no preset matches, so facets are set explicitly and equal the facets.json defaults except archetype, surfaces, posture and data.
